cli.out:
usage: ev-charging [-h] [--version] [--config CONFIG]
                   {config,sign-in,book,run,approvals,status,autostart} ...

ev-charging: book an office EV charging slot when your calendar asks for one.

ev-charging config                  create the settings file (if missing) and say where it is
ev-charging sign-in                 sign in to Microsoft, then to the form in the tool's Edge window
ev-charging book 2026-11-26         fill in the form and screenshot it; submits nothing
ev-charging book 2026-11-26 --submit    and submit it (a request, approved by email)
ev-charging run --dry-run           what the daily run would book, ask and rename; changes nothing
ev-charging run                     book what the calendar asks for, apply approvals, list questions
ev-charging run --hook              then pass the report to the settings' after_run command
ev-charging approvals [--dry-run]   only apply the approval emails to the calendar
ev-charging status                  requests from today on, and whether each is approved
ev-charging autostart on            run daily at daily_at and at logon, and now (off, status)

positional arguments:
  {config,sign-in,book,run,approvals,status,autostart}
    config              create the settings file if missing, and say where it
                        is
    sign-in             sign in to Microsoft, and to the form in the tool's
                        Edge window
    book                fill in (and with --submit, submit) the form for one
                        day
    run                 the daily run: book, apply approvals, list questions
    approvals           only apply the approval emails to the calendar
    status              requests from today on, and whether each is approved
    autostart           run daily and at logon (Task Scheduler)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --config CONFIG       settings file (default %APPDATA%\ev-
                        charging\config.toml)

template:
# ev-charging settings. See the README for what each one does.

login_hint = "you@example.com"         # your work sign-in, for Microsoft Graph
# tenant = "organizations"             # or your organisation's tenant id
# timezone = "GMT Standard Time"       # Windows name of your time zone, for calendar times
# car_file = "%LOCALAPPDATA%/ev-charging/car.json"   # your car's details: keep it out of any repo
# daily_at = "09:00"                   # when autostart's daily run happens (and at logon)

[booking]
days_ahead = 14          # how far ahead to look
start_time = "08:00"     # the slot you ask for
slot_hours = 4           # how long a slot lasts
notice_days = 1          # the first day considered is today + this
weekdays_only = true

[trigger]
# A calendar entry whose subject matches `entry` is the day's travel block; it asks for a slot when its
# subject also matches `book`. Both are case-insensitive regular expressions.
entry = '^\s*travel'
book = '\bev\b'
label = "Travel block"   # what to call it in questions
work_plan = "office"     # the Outlook work plan must say this to book; "" to ignore the work plan

[form]
url = "https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=YOUR-FORM-ID"
questions = 6            # how many questions the form has: anything else stops the booking
confirmation = "response was submitted|Your response was|Thanks"

# One [[form.field]] per question to fill, by its position on the form (1 is the first).
# type: date, choice (a dropdown) or text. value: {date:...}, {start}, or any key in car_file.
[[form.field]]
question = 1
type = "date"
value = "{date:%d/%m/%Y}"

[[form.field]]
question = 2
type = "choice"
value = "{start}"

[[form.field]]
question = 3
type = "text"
value = "{car_make}"

[approvals]
sender = "facilities@example.com"
subject = "electric car charging request"
approved = "APPROVED"
declined = "DECLIN|REJECT"
date = 'Date\s*-\s*(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})'
start = 'Start Time\s*-\s*(\d{1,2}:\d{2})'
point = 'assigned;\s*(.+?\))'
# charge_points = ["Charger 1"]   # optional: names to look for if `point` finds nothing
rename = "Travel; EV – {point}, {start}–{end}"
